slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: No goal. No questions. No plan.
slides.right:
Give AI the context,
get a prep sheet.

slides.label: Step 1
slides.title: Set the goal
slides.sub: Know what a win looks like
slides.card: I have a meeting with [who] about [topic]. Help me define one clear goal and 3 outcomes I want.

slides.label: Step 2
slides.title: Know the person
slides.card: Here's what I know about [person/company]: [notes]. What do they likely care about? Mark guesses.

slides.label: Step 3
slides.title: Prep questions
slides.card: Write 5 smart questions I can ask. Make 2 of them about their biggest risk or priority.

slides.label: Step 4
slides.title: Expect pushback
slides.card: What objections might they raise? Give me a short, honest answer to each.

slides.label: Step 5
slides.title: Plan the close
slides.card: Draft a 3-line closing: what we agreed, who does what, by when.
slides.note: Then add your own facts. AI can't know your history.

scenes.headline: AI sounds sure. Even when it's wrong.

scenes.title: THE FOLLOW-UP
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: List every claim in your answer. Mark each one: sure, unsure or guessed. Then tell me what I should double-check and where to find a source.

scenes.title: What you get
scenes.footer: Then check the ones that matter.

scenes.text: What did AI get wrong for you?
scenes.note: AI can misjudge its own certainty. Always check key facts.
